name: Survivor
summary: Reroll an Initiative of 9 or lower, and once per Long Rest add your Proficiency Bonus to a save against being Charmed or Frightened.

benefits.name: Hypervigilance
benefits.summary: When your Initiative d20 shows 9 or lower, reroll it and use the new roll.
benefits.text: An Initiative d20 showing 9 or lower can be rolled again; the new roll stands.

benefits.name: Steel Yourself
benefits.summary: Reaction, once per Long Rest: add your Proficiency Bonus to a save against Charmed or Frightened.
benefits.text: Failing a save to avoid or end Charmed or Frightened, you can spend your Reaction to add your Proficiency Bonus to it, which may turn it into a success. Once per Long Rest.
